basis.o2_secondary: 1.6 L water volume at 30 MPa, 0.60 kg O2: 30 min open-loop purge at a 2 kPa ppCO2 limit ([life_support]): PROVISIONAL

basis.membrane_evaporator: SWME class: PROVISIONAL, heat rejection OPEN

life_support.verified: packing volume only; no capability is verified

life_support_budget.status: PROVISIONAL design targets (data/eva_suit.toml [life_support]); not IGNITION canon, not a qualification

peak.note: 15 min peaks are inside the nominal profile; the SWME and fan are sized for the peak load

life_support_budget.separation: breathing O2 and propulsion N2 have separate vessels, regulators and manifolds; no shared line or cross-connect
monitoring: time remaining = min over every consumable, shown on the cuff and relayed by the drone
plumbing: vent loop: fan -> swing bed -> helmet inlet over the visor -> return at the wrists and ankles
LCVG water loop: pump -> SWME -> gas trap -> garment
feedwater: hatch bladder -> SWME, back-pressure valve
O2: primary and secondary COPVs on separate regulators into the vent loop, secondary also feeds the purge valve
propulsion N2: reserve COPV and the drone's dock probe on their own manifold; no line, valve or regulator is shared with breathing gas
life_support_budget.limits: steady-state rates; no transient thermal model, no CO2 bed sizing or humidity condensation model; suit pressure EVA-004 OPEN

structure.status: PRELIMINARY analytical estimate: limit loads x FoS, closed-form sections; no FE, no test, not a qualification

anchor.same_interface: the hull service socket copies the suit channel, so the dock figures apply

anchor_gripper.note: the 300 N anchor-gripper rating holds for loads within this angle of the tool axis; beyond it the GU-SIF-S preload (fleet standard, unchanged) opens the flange: anchored work uses the keel socket instead

structure.unknowns: channel-wall bearing, module-to-cuirass mount and composite shell laminates need FE and test; the moment reaches the wearer only through the hard torso

A.actuator: strain-wave (harmonic) joint drives, 40-60 mm frame: about 20-45 N m peak each, back-drivable brake off

B.actuator: strain-wave (harmonic) joint drives, 40-60 mm frame: about 20-45 N m peak each, back-drivable brake off

larger objects, stabilisation, handrail anchoring; 2 x 22 mm, 150 N grip
fasteners and panels: 1/4 in hex, 0.5-5 N m, reaction tab
borescope for narrow gaps (interface defined only)
particulate and scraping samples, sealed canister

anchored.note: the keel locks into a hull service socket that copies the suit channel; the 5 N m driver reaction and 60 N tip load are far inside the rating (ratings PROTOTYPE)

near_suit_faults.limits: rigid-body, steady thrust, no plume interaction forces, no sensor or navigation error model; latch and manifold rupture are design-for-minimum-risk items, not covered by fault tolerance

results.rule: no NaN vertex, no zero-area face
every mesh at unit scale (geometry carries the size)
no linked library, every image and font packed: the review file opens anywhere
metres, real scale: a 1.55-2.0 m wearer; drone 0.40-0.60 x 0.45-0.70 x 0.15-0.30 m (stowed)
docked: the drone frame is the suit dock socket
in every state with propulsion armed, no live plume (axis + 12 deg cone to 1.2 m) hits the astronaut, module, other clusters, arms, sensors or covers
no arm touches the drone body, covers, vessels or clusters, or the other arm, in any state
stowed and carried tools clear of the drone body
every keyed arm pose inside data/eva_drone.toml joint ranges
the drone touches the astronaut and module only through the dock hardware (bolts, keel, load pads), in every state

fold-out controller: deployed in flight / drone-deployed / chase with the grip axis <= 60 mm from the left palm centre and the glove <= 10 mm from the grip (hand at the grip, no contact); stowed otherwise; never touching the suit or the drone, >= 20 mm from the manual release; yaw and telescope inside their stops in every state
the soft outer layer (limbs and trunk) never passes through the rigid torso shell, module or helmet in any state
arms folded: no forward sensor ray (30 deg cone, 1 m) meets the drone itself
the drone backs straight off the channel from 5 mm to 0.6 m without touching the suit
near-suit mode (22 live nozzles): no 30 deg plume fringe reaches the astronaut or module with the drone on the dock axis 0.5-0.03 m out

3D envelope (axis + rings to 30 deg, out to the 1 Pa on-axis range) in every armed state, on the approach from 2 m and through the arm motions made with the thrusters armed: no core hit, sensitive surfaces <= 1.0 Pa, everything else <= 5.0 Pa (Simons estimate)
drone alone: all 12 pure axes
docked (the drone's near-suit set flies the pair, suit reserve isolated): all 12
suit reserve alone: all 12
within 1.5 m of a suit (near-suit mode, the plume-clear set above): all 12 pure axes, including +Z (back away) for retreat and abort

built near-suit nozzle set, real mass and inertia: approach, braking, alignment, capture and abort / retreat each keep the force and torque they need (x control margin) with any one nozzle failed closed; capture and lost-braking contact energy inside the capture mechanism's capacity
every named pose reached (residual < 0.5 mm, approach < 0.5 deg) with every joint in range
from the deployed (ready) pose, the in-file IK control (ik_A / ik_B bone + property) brings the flange to each named target within 2 mm
all four pads within 1.5 mm of the grapple post (line contacts), no pad, jaw or body inside it
driver bit engages a fastener (<= 3 mm) without entering the flange
every swept head point inside the helmet with >= 15 mm to the shell (data [form] head_motion_deg)
docked assistance pose: arms and tools >= 30 mm from the helmet, >= 50 mm from the release handle, reserve valve, gauge and tether hooks, no contact with the astronaut
both tool working points inside the visor's horizontal field (azimuth from straight ahead <= the visor half-width)
nominal case covers 8.0 h + 1.0 h on O2, feedwater and battery; secondary O2 gives >= 30 min purge; packed items fit the module (high case is reported, not required)
limit loads x FoS 1.5 inside the dock / anchor ratings, arm-root links and tool couplings; emergency release within a gloved pull

results.statement: The budget (O2 0.0638 kg/h, feedwater 0.382 kg/h, 60.0 W electronics) is a steady-state estimate; no transient thermal, CO2-bed sizing or humidity model, no test. EVA-004 suit pressure stays OPEN.
Closed-form limit-load estimate only: channel-wall bearing, the module-to-cuirass mount and the composite laminates need FE and test.

Reach is limited to beside and above the helmet; arm forces react into the suit through the dock, so the astronaut must be anchored (foot restraint or handrail) and the drone thrusters stay inhibited. Moving parts beside the helmet need a crew-commanded hold-to-run mode and a force limit; no human-in-the-loop evaluation exists.

The 3D envelope is a sampled Simons far-field estimate (no flow solution, reflection or contamination transport): it bounds where plumes reach, not their effect on coatings or optics; not a qualification.
